_comment: Each level lists only the words that level adds. STANDARD includes LIGHT and STRICT includes STANDARD automatically — never repeat a word across levels. Repeated Latin letters collapse before matching (asshole → ashole), so avoid short words whose collapsed form is an ordinary word (ass → as, piss → pis(tol), hell → hel(lo)). Matching rules: native/blitzlink-relay/src/chat_filter.rs.
